facts.business: iValue Infosolutions is a multi-OEM, services-enabled, solution-led technology aggregator focused on cybersecurity, hybrid cloud, AI infrastructure, AI security, AI data platforms, AI operations, data infrastructure, application modernization, managed services, and renewals.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Gross margin estimate of 57% based on management's strategic initiatives including transition to system integrator model, expansion into new geographies (MEA), and strengthened leadership.
Employee growth rate of 17% reflects a calibrated hiring strategy aligned with operational efficiencies and automation initiatives.
Long term growth rate is the weighted average growth rate used to extrapolate cash flows beyond the budget period, consistent with industry reports.
Weighted average cost of capital derived at 13% with cost of equity at 16% and cost of debt at 7%.

auditor.name: Price Waterhouse & Co Chartered Accountants LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: No qualifications, reservations, adverse remarks or disclaimers in the audit report for FY 2025-26.

key_risks: Recoverable amount of CGU sensitive to changes in revenue growth (25% to 22%), gross margin (57% to 52%), employee benefits (17% to 21%), long-term growth rate (2% to 0%), and pre-tax discount rate (13% to 24%).
Dues to MSME suppliers increased significantly to Rs 1,195 Lakhs as at March 31, 2026 from Rs 3 Lakhs in prior year.
facts.related_party_note: Related party transactions include reimbursement of expenses from subsidiaries and key management personnel. Enterprise exercising significant influence: Sundara Mauritius Ltd. Wholly owned subsidiaries: Asia iValue Pte Ltd, iValue S L (Private) Limited, iValue Infosolutions SEA Co. Limited. Subsidiaries: Quantanxt Technologies Private Limited, ASPL Info Services (FZE).
